Sergio —

Below is a concise first-pass commercial + tech breakdown you can share. Numbers are illustrative; legal should confirm language in the SOW.

Audit log retention (add-on):
- 30 days: included in base (no additional fee)
- 90 days: $1,500 / month (flat tier) or $0.02 / GB-month if usage far exceeds baseline (>10GB/month)
- 365 days: $6,000 / month or $0.015 / GB-month for high-volume customers

Premium controls (SKU: REDW-PREM-C): $2,500 / month includes:
- Role-based export controls and fine-grained audit streams
- Encrypted archival export via customer KMS (HSM integration priced separately)
- Priority access to retention recall requests (SLA target 4 hours)

Commit & discount guidance (example):
- No commit (self-serve): add-ons billed month-to-month, no discount
- 6-month commit (minimum): 5% discount on add-ons and platform usage if committed ARR >= $60k
- 12-month commit: 10% discount if committed ARR >= $120k; 15% discount for >= $200k ARR
- Overcommit / ramp program: if they move from pilot to 3x baseline commit within 3 months, apply a one-time onboarding credit equal to one month of add-ons (cap $10k)

SOW & data sizing notes:
- For 90-day retention we estimate 4GB/day of audit data at 100k tokens/month (depends on verbosity of logs). That's ~120GB/month. Use GB-based pricing for >10GB/month; otherwise flat tier applies.
- Include an appendix in the SOW: retention SLA, export process, deletion timeline, and proof of deletion flow.

I'll draft a one-page SOW stub (SOW_stub.docx) for procurement + legal. Evelyn, if you can look for any hard no's re: retention SLA or export controls before I send, that'd be great.
